sources.title: cjvt/GaMS-2B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Card for GaMS-2B GaMS-2B, GaMS-9B and GaMS-27B represent new improved and larger models of the GaMS (Generative Model for Slovene) familly. The models are based on Google's Gemma 2 familly and continually pretrained on Slovene, English and some portion of Croatian, Serbian and Bosnian corpora.
